_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every piece of proof on the site — case studies, numbers, testimonials, work samples, credentials. Every service page renders its proof from here. Nothing proof-related is hardcoded in a template.
_how_to_use: Each service has a `proof` array. Each item has a `status`: FILLED (renders live), EMPTY (renders as a labelled placeholder on staging, hidden on production), or DRAFT (content written, awaiting permission). Kamar fills EMPTY slots by changing status and adding the fields. No developer needed.
_rule: An item with status FILLED must have every required field. A missing field on a FILLED item fails the build — this is deliberate, so a half-filled proof block can never ship.

block_types.result_strip: 3-4 hard numbers in a row. Needs: value, label, context.
block_types.case_study: Client, sector, city, one headline number, link to the full page.
block_types.before_after: One metric, before and after, with the time period.
block_types.testimonial: Named person, role, business. No anonymous quotes, ever.
block_types.logo_wall: Client logos. Written permission required for each.
block_types.work_sample: Screenshot or photo of the actual thing built, with a caption.
block_types.credential: Company registration, GST, platform certifications, team credentials.
block_types.live_metric: Pulled live at build time — Google review score and count.
